name: A precaution on a tool call that waits
what: An extension granted the tool that protects a computer's requests can be asked about each tool call in that computer's model replies, and that tool call waits for its answer. If it denies the tool call, the model sees its own tool call with an error that says it was denied. If it holds the tool call, the ask you get shows its answer as an opinion.

suggest.why: It gives any agent program the mode in which each action is looked at before it runs, which today only some programs have.
